encoding.json: UTF-8 compact JSON, node arrays, object fields in record order, exactly one LF terminator
encoding.integers: canonical base-10 string with optional leading minus and no redundant leading zeroes
encoding.product: constructor tuple payload in OCaml source order; never rely on OCaml evaluation order
encoding.maps: Map entries are [key,value] pairs sorted by canonical key bytes then canonical value bytes
encoding.sets: Set values sorted by canonical bytes
encoding.paths: fixture-root-relative POSIX path encoded as lowercase byte hex
encoding.locations: one-based lines, zero-based byte columns, zero-based half-open byte offsets

identity.allocation: assign [kind,index] on first deterministic preorder encounter from roots
identity.references: every shared graph object is emitted once as Definition and subsequently as Reference
identity.boundVariables: DeBruijn with zero denoting the innermost binder
identity.sourceNames: preserved as Bytes even when not valid UTF-8
identity.origin: user/generated provenance is semantic and serialized without runtime tags

constructorPayloadEncoding.record: record tag followed by canonicalV3Fields in upstream declaration order
constructorPayloadEncoding.recursiveReference: Reference when the object already has a Definition; otherwise allocate before descending

nodeEncoding: Each node is a JSON array whose first element is its exact tag and whose remaining elements follow nodeFieldOrder.
